europe_now.title: Major Incident Near UK Airbase
europe_now.summary: British police arrested five men on terrorism and explosive offenses following a major incident near an airbase utilized by United States forces. Authorities also evacuated nearby residential homes as counter-terrorism squads investigated the situation.

sources.headline: UK: Police arrest 5 on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act
Major incident declared at UK air base used by US forces

europe_now.title: Swiss Neutrality Vote
europe_now.summary: Switzerland rejected a proposal to adopt a stricter interpretation of its traditional neutrality policy. The outcome maintains the country's existing framework and safeguards its current sanctions on Russia.

sources.headline: Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality
Swiss say no to hardening neutrality principle, safeguarding sanctions on Russia

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV traveled to France for an apostolic visit that included an open-air mass at the Lourdes pilgrimage site. During the visit, he addressed the Catholic Church's abuse crisis and condemned assisted dying.

sources.headline: Church confronts shock of abuse crisis
'Scourge' of abuse must be rooted out, says Pope during Lourdes visit

top_stories.title: European Energy Pressures
top_stories.summary: Ongoing conflicts in the Middle East are pushing Europe toward the risk of another severe energy crisis. In response to surging costs, the European Commission has called on member countries to actively reduce their gas and electricity demands.

sources.headline: EU Commission calls on countries to cut energy demands as costs surge
Middle East conflicts push Europe toward a second energy crisis in five years

top_stories.title: Housing Protests in Spain
top_stories.summary: Growing frustration over soaring living expenses culminated in a major protest in Madrid over the housing crisis. Urban centers across Europe are actively searching for new strategies to boost the availability of affordable housing.
